project.title: The Desk Wakes Up
project.logline: A creator's scattered assets become a living production desk where managed agents transform music, movement, safety, and remix instructions into a coherent music video.

sections.label: intro
sections.visual_opportunity: Raw creator assets float before organization.

sections.label: verse
sections.visual_opportunity: Agents organize assets and extract creator DNA.

sections.label: chorus
sections.visual_opportunity: Multiple generated worlds branch from one movement motif.

sections.label: break
sections.visual_opportunity: IP safety rewrite becomes visual proof.

style_bible.visual_language: Futuristic production studio, black glass, white graph lines, luminous creator media cards, neon accents, precise camera movement, editorial UI overlays.
camera_language: smooth orbital moves around the desk
negative_constraints: no recognizable copyrighted costumes, logos, or vehicles
no real-person face unless user-provided with consent

scenes.title: Scattered Inputs
scenes.description: A black glass desk floats in darkness while creator assets drift around it as translucent media cards.

scenes.title: Flash Planning Pass
scenes.description: A production graph forms and specialist agent labels light up around the desk.

scenes.title: Creator DNA Extraction
scenes.description: An abstract light-dancer gesture becomes movement rules, camera paths, wardrobe geometry, and color trails.

scenes.title: Scene Worlds Branch
scenes.description: Three original worlds unfold from the same movement rhythm: neon rooftop, chrome train platform, desert signal tower.

scenes.title: IP Safety Rewrite
scenes.description: Risky references are redacted and rewritten into original descriptive terms, then stamped safe.

scenes.title: Timeline Assembly
scenes.description: Generated clips snap into a vertical timeline with beat markers and remix branch indicators.

scenes.title: Final Frame
scenes.description: The desk folds into the Omnidesk wordmark with the line: Original. Remixable. Rights-aware.
